authority: owner statement 2026-08-15; formalizes the arithmetic the overlays already use

definitions.fair_line_from_model: p >= .5: american = -100*p/(1-p); p < .5: american = +100*(1-p)/p. The model's probability is set FIRST, independent of any price (forecast first, price second).
definitions.break_even_from_posted_price: negative m: p_be = |m|/(|m|+100); positive m: p_be = 100/(m+100). This is the vig-INCLUSIVE threshold of one posted price at one source — it is NOT a market probability estimate and requires no de-vig.
definitions.edge: edge = p_model - p_be, per side, per posted price.
definitions.ev_per_unit: EV = p_model*(dec-1) - (1-p_model), where dec = 1 + (m/100 if m>0 else 100/|m|).
definitions.identity: EV = p_model/p_be - 1, hence sign(EV) == sign(edge) always — the two screens can never disagree on direction, only on magnitude.

verified_against_live_record: WNBA-OVERLAY-2026-08-14 DAL@IND: p_model(IND)=.6312 -> IND -290: p_be .7436, edge -.1124, EV -.1511; DAL +250: p_be .2857, edge +.0831, EV +.2908 — matches the pushed overlay to the rounding digit.
boundaries: PERMITTED: edge/EV vs a SINGLE posted price (break-even needs no de-vig and makes no market-probability claim). This is the only sanctioned use of cross-book best-odds prices (8/3 ruling: EV-screen only).

FORBIDDEN: constructing 'market probability' by de-vigging a cross-book best-odds pair (8/3 ruling). Two-sided SAME-BOOK de-vig for market-implied context remains permitted and must be labeled MARKET-IMPLIED, never a forecast.
FORBIDDEN: prices as model inputs. p_model must exist before the price is looked at; an edge computed from a price-influenced probability is circular.
SCOPE: NFL preseason capture artifacts FORBID ev/edge/implied_probability fields entirely (line-guard FORBIDDEN_KEYS) — no model exists there, so the frame has no left-hand side.

AUTHORITY: a positive edge/EV is a SCREEN, not a wager instruction. Five-part test still applies (executable single-book price, injury state, prospective sample, gate, authority). Gate 0/100 NO_PROMOTE; wager authority NO; stake $0.
